backing.collateral_ratio_basis: INHERITED from yzUSD. syzUSD is an ERC-4626 vault whose asset is yzUSD, so a claim on syzUSD is worth what the underlying yzUSD is backed by. ⚠️ totalAssets/totalSupply is a NAV, not a collateral ratio — publishing it here would rate the vault's own bookkeeping at ~108% and say nothing about the reserve.
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: inherited from yzUSD, same basis as the ratio

market_price_cross_check.note: ⚠️ THE TWO MARKS DISAGREE BY 290bps AND BOTH ARE LIVE. The published mark is the SMALLER Monad pool ($106,572 reserve, $0.00 traded in 24h); routing reaches the 3.5x larger csUSDC pool. Against NAV that is 0.21% versus -2.695% — so the headline discount depends on which venue you call the market. Two pools 3.5x apart quoting one asset differently, unarbitraged, IS the liquidity finding; it is published rather than resolved by picking a side.

peg.nav_basis: the on-chain ERC-4626 NAV (a redemption value, not a peg)
peg.note: Market price from peg_tracker:geckoterminal_pool against the on-chain ERC-4626 NAV (a redemption value, not a peg). ⚠️ 24h volume is $963.68 — a deviation struck on this little turnover is weak evidence about fair value and strong evidence about exit cost. Both readings belong.

depth_50bps.basis: The 50bps crossing is BRACKETED between $100,000 (clears) and $150,000 (129bps). Published figure is the last rung that cleared, so the true depth sits inside the bracket and above what is shown. Not interpolated -- rung spacing is too coarse to locate it and the curve is not linear across the gap. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

liquidity.total_2pct_depth_note: Routed KyberSwap ladder on Monad, selling into csUSDC — ACROSS Monad venues, not one pool. ⚠️ The -528bps-at-$50k figure that circulated for syzUSD was the $108K wnAUSD pool alone; routing reaches the 3.5x larger $374,787 csUSDC pool and the same size costs ~4.4bps. 24h volume is $963.68, so turnover is thin while DEPTH is not — different facts, and this asset separates them.
liquidity.pools_note: Swap venues only. ⚠️ Lending markets are listed under asset_specific.lending_exposure: they are the larger numbers and they are a liquidation-risk fact, not a peg fact — a venue that cannot quote the asset cannot price it.

exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

liquidity.by_chain_note: Swap, lending and issuer-vault TVL per chain, all from the same DefiLlama enumeration so the three are comparable. ⚠️ A chain with vault TVL and NO swap venue has no local exit — the aggregate cannot say that. ⚠️ And this is DefiLlama's view of the chain set: riskAnalyst read syzUSD satellites on Pharos and Berachain that DefiLlama does not list, so the chain count here is a FLOOR, not a census. Vault TVL is also not the same quantity as mirrored supply read on-chain; the two are close but must not be mixed.

primary_exit.gated_note: ⚠️ THE WRAPPER UNWRAP IS OPEN; THE ONWARD REDEMPTION IS NOT — do not read this as 'the exit is open'. syzUSD -> yzUSD redeems permissionlessly on Plasma: not paused, maxRedeem uncapped for an address nobody would allowlist (0x…dEaD), and an eth_call of redeem() FROM that address executes. yzUSD -> USD remains KYC-gated and accredited-only, and syzUSD held on Monad has no redeem path at all — bridge to Plasma or sell. ⚠️ BINDING LEG: venue depth, not redemption.

risk_flags.message: RECURSIVE BACKING: $3,076,258 (4.7% of backing) is Yuzu's own yzPRIME, whose own ratio is 1.002015
LEVERAGE: $49,960,937 (76.7% of backing) sits in looped positions — a collateral ratio on a levered book is not that ratio on spot

CONCENTRATION: Ethena exposure $34,468,641 (52.9% of backing), ~4.9x the $6,975,930 surplus — but ~105x the $328,134 EX-JUNIOR cushion, and the surplus is ~90% yzPP, which is redeemable third-party capital

NO LOCAL EXIT: at least $9,062,751 of vault TVL sits on 2 chain(s) with no swap venue — Ethereum, Sei. ⚠️ A LOWER BOUND: this enumerates DefiLlama's chain list, which omits satellites read directly on-chain (Pharos, Berachain), so the true stranded total is higher. The aggregate liquidity figure is not available to these holders
UNTRACKED CHAIN: DefiLlama reports $8,811,378 of SYZUSD vault TVL on Sei, a chain absent from our records — either a deployment we do not track or a mislabel, and we do not know which
SETTLEMENT GAP: yzUSD supply is on Plasma, but only $5,295,301 of $65,172,673 backing (8.1%) is — the rest must move cross-chain to meet a redemption

SURPLUS IS JUNIOR CAPITAL: ex-junior the collateral ratio is 100.56%, not 111.99% — the headline ratio EXISTS because yzPP's first-loss capital is counted inside it. That surplus is redeemable third-party capital, not retained earnings (30-day gated withdrawal), and no attachment or detachment point is documented. yzPP is ~95% of the $6,975,930 surplus AT THIS SAMPLE — a figure that has ranged 0.1-186% across 380 points while ex-junior moved 95.9-106.1%; do not trend it.

corroboration.note: Feed figures reproduce the chain. This pairing is the only thing between this dashboard and republishing an issuer's self-reported number unchecked.

asset_specific.exposure_note: exposure_split is a snapshot at exposure_as_of while total_reserves is live, so the difference is DRIFT and grows with the table's age. Never derive total_backing from it. reserves_split (by chain) is a different field and DOES sum to total_reserves exactly.

unknowns: quorum_denominator: m_threshold is 4 OF AN UNSTATED TOTAL — the feed carries no signer count, so 4-of-5 and 4-of-25 are indistinguishable from this payload
default_action 'block': the payload does not say what is blocked, nor whether it applies on failure to reach quorum or to unrecognised calls
verifiability '100': a string with no declared scale, and no statement of whether it is measured or asserted
governance.note: ⚠️ Pass-through from the issuer's Fordefi policy, NOT measured here. Published with its unknowns named so a renderer can show '4-of-unknown' rather than inferring a denominator. TO ESTABLISH THE DENOMINATOR: the Fordefi policy's signer set, which is not in this feed — it needs the issuer's own governance disclosure or an on-chain read of the safe.

asset_specific.wallets_note: Published by the feed; balances are not queried in v1.

history_window.note: Range is over the last 30 days (1437 points), NOT the whole file — the export retains 400 days and a full-file range is roughly twice as wide, which makes a step look like noise. reserve_step_* count numerator-only moves >1% in the same window; the per-run flag clears the next hour while the level persists, so this is the durable form.
